title: Software Development: custom software for your processes | utxo AG
description: Custom software for enterprise processes: web applications, mobile apps and integrations, AI-assisted where it helps. From concept to operation.
lede: We develop software for processes that standard products do not cover well. A dedicated team stays with it from concept to operation.

faq.q: When is custom software the better choice over a standard product?
faq.a: When a process matters to your company and standard products only cover it through workarounds, side lists or manual steps. We discuss this openly in the first conversation. If a standard product fits better, we say so.

faq.q: How long does a project take?
faq.a: That depends on the scope. Some applications are in use within a few weeks, others take months. After the concept phase you receive a plan with the increments in which the application is developed.

faq.q: Does the software have to include AI?
faq.a: No. We use AI functions where they help the process, for example to read documents or to search your own data. We work model-agnostic; local open-source models are assessed per project.

faq.q: How do you connect our existing systems?
faq.a: Through the interfaces your systems provide, for example those of your ERP, CRM, DMS or SSO. Which data flows in which direction is defined in the concept together with your IT.

According to your requirements: in Germany, in the EU or on-premise. This is decided per project. The DPA is created individually for your project, and processing takes place only on your instructions.

faq.q: Who looks after the application after go-live?
faq.a: The same team that developed it. utxo AG hosts and monitors the application and implements new requirements in further versions.

scope.title: What you get
scope.text: An application that fits your process and is integrated into your system landscape. The scope depends on the project. These components come together in most of them.

points.name: Web applications
points.text: Business applications and portals for your workflows, with roles, permissions and reporting.

points.name: Mobile apps
points.text: For tasks that come up on the move: approvals, on-site data capture, notifications.

points.name: Integrations
points.text: Connections to your existing systems such as ERP, CRM, DMS and SSO, so data is maintained in one place only.

points.name: AI-assisted functions
points.text: Where it helps the process: reading documents, preparing suggestions, searching your own data. Model-agnostic.

points.name: Operation and further development
points.text: Hosting, monitoring and new versions from the same team that developed the application.

practice.title: An example from practice
practice.text: A procurement portal has been in use for some months, and the procurement team raises a new requirement. This is how it becomes a released version: concept, development, automated tests, your acceptance, production.

process.title: How a project runs
process.text: The scope determines the duration: some applications are in use within a few weeks, others take months. The sequence stays the same.

steps.name: First conversation
steps.text: You describe the process and the goal. We clarify whether custom software is the right way to get there.

steps.name: Concept and architecture
steps.text: We map the process with your departments and define scope, architecture and integrations.

steps.name: Development in increments
steps.text: The application grows in working versions. You see every state and set the priorities.

steps.name: Rollout
steps.text: Your department accepts the application. We migrate data, connect the systems and support the start.

steps.name: Operation and further development
steps.text: We host and monitor the application. The same team implements new requirements.

run.label: Animated diagram: a project runs from the first conversation through increments and acceptance into operation with further versions.

operation.title: Integration and operation
operation.text: The application works with the systems you already use. In operation you see what is running and decide what goes into production.

facts.name: Your systems
facts.text: Connected through the interfaces your systems provide. Sign-in through your SSO, roles following your organization.

facts.name: Hosting
facts.text: According to your requirements: Germany, EU or on-premise. This is defined per project.

facts.name: Monitoring
facts.text: utxo AG monitors availability, integrations and errors. Every action is logged.

facts.name: Your approval
facts.text: New versions go into production only after your acceptance.
